summary: Completed comprehensive study repair pass for Dominica prima Adventus (1962 Missale Romanum, Gemini edition) addressing all carried findings STU-002 through STU-006, syncing repaired research records (STU-001, RES-011 through RES-014) without modifying any sealed research file, and clearing advisory STU-007. X.42 sicut nubem to 'like a cloud' and PL 15 cols. 1812-1814; updated Gueranger 1870 to p. 137 separating his 'dew of heaven' from Sicard's Holy Spirit gloss and removing unsupported Collect/Secret/Postcommunion claims; attributed the Collect's direct Christological address to Qui vivis; updated Lapide Antwerp 1614 to pp. 195-198). STU-004: deleted the self-narrating opening paragraph and all seven forward-pointing 'below' signposts in sections/03. STU-006: eliminated the catch-all closing coverage subsections in sections/04 and 05 by weaving each prayer, chant, and Ordinary element organically into the exegetical argument, and cut restating closing sentences in sections/05, 06, and 07. STU-007: fixed \latin{all the trees}, \latin{komos} -> \emph{komos}, added inline translation for Dirige me in veritate tua, et doce me, and reworded 08:13 factually.
